newsitem.title: USA: NY agencies must minimize ill effects of new rules.
newsitem.headline: NY agencies must minimize ill effects of new rules.

text.p: New York State Governor George Pataki signed into law a measure that requires state agencies to minimize any ill effects of new rules they plan, said the Assemblywoman who proposed the bill on Tuesday.
A spokesman for Pataki, a Republican, had no information immediately available.

Joan Christensen, D-Syracuse, in prepared remarks, said state agencies now will have to address what impact new regulations might have on local governments. She added that such analysis previously was limited to studying any effects on small businesses.

"By extending the Regulatory Flexibility Analysis to local governments, state regulators will have to determine whether a new rule imposing costs or compliance requirements on local governments can be met with a less burdensome alternative," she said.
The Assemblywoman added that the agencies also will be olbiged to consult with local governments before proposing new rules.
